1b10393fbd.text: Lumiere Labs has put its first vitamin C serum on sale at Sephora, priced at $38. Several outlets say stock is limited for now, and a rollout to Middle East stores has started too.

f2a1b05e0f.text: Aurelia Group is buying the skincare brand Marlowe Skin. No financial terms were given, though one trade outlet reads the move as a way for Aurelia to build out its skincare range.

102e08bfaf.text: Cosmo Expo Dubai has opened with around 400 brands taking part. Fragrance and skincare drew most of the attention on the first day.

63c64fc15d.text: Dune Beauty is pulling a batch of its SPF 50 sunscreen sticks after a possible bacterial contamination was found. Anyone who owns one is told to stop using the affected lots.

639dfc9ba8.text: A Reddit post about a $9 Petal & Pine lip oil is one of the day's top posts in a skincare community, with people sharing whether they like it.

eaf553513e.text: Petal & Pine's lengthening mascara is down to £12 as the brand starts its Black Friday sale early. The discount runs until Sunday, according to The Powder Room.

ac1852741e.text: This roundup collects the sunscreen recalls announced during October, in one list.

e21b2a5d26.text: A blogger tried the barrier cream from Marlowe Skin for two weeks on dry cheeks and writes up how it went.

a34dd5484c.text: A dermatologist explains how to combine retinol and niacinamide in one routine, covering the order to apply them and how far apart to use them to keep irritation down.
